spec.rationale: Types the owner-earnings leg of the operating_business_and_net_assets prose falsifier for Cisco (CSCO). Metric definition normalized_owner_earnings_ttm_m_v2 measures trailing-twelve-month operating cash flow minus absolute TTM capital expenditures via sec_companyfacts_ttm. The low-case owner_earnings_reinvestment_dcf proof under contract_hash 9917aa0ae765 locks normalized owner earnings at 13,288 USD millions (FY2025 operating cash flow of 14,193M minus capital spending of 905M per accession 0000858877-25-000111). If FY2026 TTM normalized owner earnings at 2026-07-26 resolve below that anchor, distributable owner cash has fallen below the low-case bridge and the bounded per-share range should compress toward the low case (31.89 USD per share vs 58.05 base). Incremental after-tax ROIC and reinvestment-rate legs remain judgment inputs without a resolvable SEC metric and are not typed here. Historical adapter replay on Q3 FY2025 (measurement end 2025-04-26) resolved 12,803 USD millions; resolve_spec reproduces that value on 2026-09-26. Interim FY2026 TTM readings from the same adapter trend lower through Q3 (Q1 12,733M at 2025-10-25; Q2 12,241M at 2026-01-24; Q3 11,788M at 2026-04-25 per CSCO/research/evidence/sec_companyfacts.json), but Cisco fiscal Q4 is seasonally the strongest cash quarter, so FY-end TTM could still recover above the anchor. Target FY2026 TTM is not observable at registration; FY2026 10-K is absent from CSCO/investor-documents/DOWNLOAD_MANIFEST.json as of the admitted manifest SHA, FY2025 10-K filed 2025-09-03 while FY2026 10-K is still missing from DOWNLOAD_MANIFEST.json; observable_after is 2026-10-15 so registration on 2026-09-26 stays ex-ante. A 38% fire probability weights the trailing decline against Q4 seasonality and historically sticky enterprise networking cash flow.
